high_value_findings.finding: Room-description prompt material entered generated thoughts, was stored as topics/intents, re-injected into later prompts and even entered CVAE training, creating a self-amplifying fixation loop that survived simple keyword anti-rumination.
high_value_findings.transfer: Any adaptive FRANK/Clay learning loop needs provenance labels for externally scaffolded/context-derived content, contamination tests, lineage-aware exclusion from training, and semantic concentration detectors rather than only keyword filters.

high_value_findings.finding: Neural conscience had effectively no negative outcomes because rejection/suppression paths failed to record them, producing a near-rubber-stamp predictor; explicit negative feedback and checkpoint/data reset were required.
high_value_findings.transfer: Reward/critic modules need class-balance telemetry, outcome coverage tests and counterfactual negative paths; a high approval score without outcome diversity is not evidence of quality.

high_value_findings.finding: Voice, vision and LLM routing were aggressively collapsed toward CPU-only/3B paths while reported VRAM/RAM costs dropped and lean LoRA/RAG context replaced heavier routing/prompting.
high_value_findings.transfer: Module-collapse decisions should be benchmarked on latency, resource use, task quality and failure isolation together; reported savings are historical claims until reproduced.

high_value_findings.finding: CI policy repeatedly reversed across shallow/full clone, shared/local runners, every-push/tag-only triggering and dependency strategies in response to different failure modes and resource constraints.
high_value_findings.transfer: Preserve the full failure matrix and optimize multi-objectively; do not treat the latest CI configuration as universally superior without network, cost, OOM and reproducibility benchmarks.

high_value_findings.finding: Topic-ID concentration was added because semantic circumlocution evaded keyword cluster detection.
high_value_findings.transfer: Emergence/rumination monitors should combine semantic/entity/topic-state concentration with lexical repetition and test adversarial paraphrase cases.

negative_results_preserved: Room ambience contaminated topics, intents, recent-life context and CVAE training, creating an endogenous fixation loop.
Conscience feedback was almost all-positive because negative outcome paths were not wired.
Subconscious historical masks changed dimension and needed pad/truncate migration semantics.
Shallow clone failed with missing-object errors; full clone later failed by timeout — neither policy is universally safe.
Docker build time exploded when CPU container requirements pulled a large CUDA torch distribution.
Shared CI runners caused contention/cost constraints; local runner introduced different OOM/network considerations.
epistemic_boundary: Commit messages that call states 'consciousness', 'feelings', 'self-aware' or 'functional consciousness' are historical design/runtime framing, not independent scientific evidence. Reported memory/VRAM savings and training-set statistics are preserved as historical measurements/claims and require reproducibility checks before promotion.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual dedup against the earned-work ledger was performed.

CI factorial test across shallow/full clone, local/shared runner, clean/cache-warm network conditions and backend variants; retain Pareto frontier rather than one global setting.
